name: retool
description: Connect to Retool through its official MCP server.

app.kipster.name: Retool
app.kipster.addressPrompt: What is your Retool instance or account MCP address?

research.notes: Retool's MCP (org and user management, app building) is per instance (template URL) with OAuth 2.0; the mcp.retool.com metadata advertises DCR, token auth none, S256. The MCP manages the person's own Retool organization (apps, users, resources), but its retool_execute_resource_ts tool runs code through Retool against connected databases and APIs, so a plugin should leave that tool out rather than use Retool as a route to other services' data.

probe.reason: An instance or account MCP address is required when connecting
